description: Five rheometer test runs on neat resin span temperature and shear rate. Compare a temperature-activated viscosity with a shear-thinning constitutive system. Complete instrument runs are held out, and nonpositive instrument readings are retained in the private exclusion ledger.
limitations: Neat-resin subset of the source collection; no claim about all syntactic-foam formulations
Replicate test runs, not independently synthesized batches
38 nonpositive native readings are excluded by a predeclared physical-validity rule; noisy positive readings remain
No source torque-resolution uncertainty model; high-temperature low-viscosity measurements may be unreliable
Retrospective engineering evidence; external scientific review remains unassessed

evidence.scope: Registered source terms, verified against source record; no external review claim

title: Resin flow across temperature and shear
